chapter_title_en: The Wind Rises Overseas: Devouring the Flood Dragon
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 560: Han Li’s Gold Devourer Beetles vs. a Self-Healing Demon Turtle
chapter_meta_description: Han Li unleashes a hundred-thousand Beetle swarm to devour the Poison Flood Dragon, but the turtle demon’s Self-Healing Body turns the battle into a grinding stalemate.
og_title: Insect Tide Devours a Flood Dragon — But What About the Turtle?
og_description: Han Li’s Gold Devourer Beetles overwhelm the Poison Flood Dragon, but a Self-Healing turtle demon forces him to rethink his war of attrition.
twitter_title: Han Li’s 100,000 Beetle Swarm vs. a Regenerating Turtle
twitter_description: The flood dragon falls, but the turtle demon’s Self-Healing Body makes attrition warfare useless. Time for Plan B.

lore_anchors.definition: Rare metallic-eating insects that can evolve into a nearly indestructible swarm; Han Li’s primary attrition weapon.
An innate constitution that grants a demon beast rapid wound recovery and limb regeneration; extremely rare in high-grade beasts.
A rare spirit beast that can paralyze and capture souls; still in its juvenile stage, so its power is limited.
The condensed life essence of a demon beast; both a cultivation resource and a vessel for the beast’s soul.
A technique that merges multiple flying swords of the same set into a single giant sword for exponentially greater destructive power.
An unfinished demonic treasure of immense speed; Han Li forcibly claims it from Feng Xi.
